div.span: Redis, keys are mostly run or user scoped
One request, tenant bound by the auth dependency
Model providers: prompt and system text

VELARIS_DATA: sealed sqlite stores,
files, trace.jsonl hash chain

Vault master key file
outside VELARIS_DATA, mode 0600

pipeline:events channel, pipeline:history list 24 h,
pipeline:control cancel and pause flag 1 h

Identity: organisations, users,
api_keys, org_api_keys, saml_configs,
scim_groups, portal_tokens

Runs: runs with checkpoint JSON,
run_specs, decisions, phase_completions,
pipeline_events, snapshots

Artifact index: artifact_embeddings
text plus vector, pgvector if present

Billing and spend: billing_payments,
token_budget_records, llm_call_records,
llm_traces, llm_cache_entries

Audit: audit_log rows plus audit_chain
one hash chain per org, audit_checkpoints
org_id taken from the DB user row
